themeCards.title: Treasury ≥$4bn long-end buybacks are the US rates / equity / USD sleeve
themeCards.fact: Treasury: 10–20Y and 20–30Y liquidity-support buybacks from $2bn max to at least $4bn per operation, Sep 9–Nov 4. CNBC: 10Y 4.647% (−5.7 bp); 30Y 5.196% (−9 bp). AP: S&P 7,707.98 (+0.2%), first gain in four days. Cointelegraph: BTC $69,749 (+6%). Aug 19 市场一览 still reads 长债收益率高企 (CLAIM — Tue tape).
themeCards.mechanism: This is a scheduled size lift from Sep 9, not QE and not a close print. Equities and BTC are the same duration-beta bounce. CICC CLAIM (Aug 19 固收): 海外美债短期仍高位波动、30Y-10Y利差或仍有上升风险; 中期中枢下行.
themeCards.trigger: First ≥$4bn operation that fails to hold the 30Y fade.
themeCards.invalidator: 30Y reclaiming the pre-announcement high with no size follow-through.

themeCards.title: Minutes hike-if-inflation is the policy book next to the buyback fade
themeCards.fact: Minutes: many participants assessed policy tightening would likely be necessary if inflation did not decline; some said financial conditions might not be sufficiently restrictive. Hold 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent; three members preferred +25 bp. CNBC: 9–3; Warsh discussed six meetings vs eight, no 2026 change. UK CPI +2.9% in line; EA final 2.9%.
themeCards.mechanism: Buybacks eased the long end the same day minutes kept hike optionality. Do not read the 30Y fade as a dovish Committee. Jackson Hole is the next Warsh microphone.
themeCards.trigger: Warsh language that restates hike-if-inflation into September.
themeCards.invalidator: Soft pipeline that retires hike odds without a 30Y extension.

themeCards.mechanism: One STAR name is not July retail. Overnight plumbing ended; 7-day zero is demand-for-funds, not an easing cycle. A-share beta stays the miss until August retail/FAI.
themeCards.invalidator: August prints that reverse the 0.6/−6.7 miss.
